column2: Spaghetti, Eggs, Parmesan cheese, Pancetta, Black pepper, Salt
column4: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente. Meanwhile, sauté diced pancetta in a skillet until crisp. In a bowl, whisk eggs with grated Parmesan. Drain pasta, reserving ½ cup of cooking water. Toss hot pasta with pancetta, remove from heat, and quickly stir in egg mixture, adding reserved water as needed to create a creamy sauce. Season generously with black pepper.

column2: Chicken breast, Yogurt, Tomato puree, Garam masala, Garlic, Ginger, Onion
column4: Cut chicken into cubes and marinate in yogurt mixed with garam masala, garlic, and ginger for at least 30 minutes. Sauté chopped onion in oil until golden. Add marinated chicken and cook until browned. Stir in tomato puree and simmer for 20 minutes until chicken is cooked through and sauce thickens. Adjust seasoning and serve hot.

column2: Broccoli, Bell peppers, Carrots, Soy sauce, Garlic, Sesame oil
column4: Heat sesame oil in a wok over high heat. Add sliced carrots and cook for 2 minutes. Add broccoli and bell peppers, stir‑frying until tender‑crisp. Stir in minced garlic and soy sauce, tossing to coat evenly. Cook for 1–2 minutes more and serve immediately.

column2: Ground beef, Taco shells, Lettuce, Tomato, Cheddar cheese, Sour cream
column4: Brown ground beef in a skillet with taco seasoning until cooked through. Warm taco shells. Fill each shell with beef, then top with shredded lettuce, diced tomato, grated cheddar, and a dollop of sour cream.

column2: Pizza dough, Tomato sauce, Mozzarella cheese, Fresh basil, Olive oil, Salt
column4: Preheat oven to 475°F (245°C). Spread tomato sauce evenly over rolled‑out pizza dough. Top with sliced mozzarella. Bake until crust is golden and cheese is bubbling, about 12–15 minutes. Remove from oven and finish with fresh basil leaves and a drizzle of olive oil.

column2: Red lentils, Carrots, Celery, Onion, Garlic, Vegetable broth, Cumin
column4: Sauté diced onion, carrots, celery, and garlic in olive oil until softened. Add rinsed lentils and vegetable broth. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20–25 minutes until lentils are tender. Stir in cumin, adjust seasoning, and serve warm.

column2: Rice noodles, Shrimp, Eggs, Bean sprouts, Peanuts, Tamarind paste, Fish sauce
column4: Soak rice noodles according to package instructions. Sauté shrimp in oil until pink. Push shrimp aside and scramble eggs in the same pan. Add noodles, tamarind paste, and fish sauce, tossing to combine. Stir in bean sprouts. Garnish with crushed peanuts before serving.

column2: Cucumber, Tomato, Red onion, Feta cheese, Kalamata olives, Olive oil, Oregano
column4: Chop cucumber, tomato, and red onion into bite‑sized pieces. Toss with Kalamata olives and crumbled feta. Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with oregano. Mix gently and serve chilled.

column2: Flour, Eggs, Milk, Baking powder, Sugar, Butter, Salt
column4: Whisk flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt in a bowl. Add milk and eggs, mixing until smooth. Heat a skillet with butter. Pour batter to form pancakes and cook until bubbles form, then flip and cook until golden brown. Serve warm.

column2: Ground beef, Kidney beans, Tomato paste, Onion, Garlic, Chili powder, Cumin
column4: Brown ground beef in a large pot. Add chopped onion and garlic, cooking until softened. Stir in tomato paste, chili powder, and cumin. Add kidney beans and simmer for 30 minutes until flavors meld. Adjust seasoning and serve hot.

column2: Eggplant, Marinara sauce, Mozzarella cheese, Parmesan cheese, Bread crumbs, Olive oil
column4: Slice eggplant and dredge in bread crumbs. Arrange on a baking sheet, drizzle with olive oil, and bake until golden. In a casserole dish, layer baked eggplant with marinara sauce, mozzarella, and Parmesan. Repeat layers and bake at 375°F (190°C) until bubbly and cheese is melted.

column2: Chicken thighs, Soy sauce, Brown sugar, Garlic, Ginger, Cornstarch
column4: Whisk soy sauce, brown sugar, minced garlic, and grated ginger to make sauce. Sear chicken thighs in a skillet until browned. Pour sauce over chicken and simmer until cooked through. Mix cornstarch with water, add to pan, and cook until sauce thickens.

column2: Chickpeas, Garlic, Onion, Parsley, Cumin, Flour, Pita bread, Tahini sauce
column4: Blend chickpeas, garlic, onion, parsley, cumin, and flour into a coarse mixture. Shape into balls and fry until crisp. Warm pita bread, fill with falafel, and drizzle with tahini sauce.

column2: Arborio rice, Butternut squash, Onion, Vegetable broth, Parmesan cheese, White wine
column4: Sauté diced onion in butter until softened. Add Arborio rice and toast for 2 minutes. Deglaze with white wine. Gradually add hot vegetable broth, stirring constantly until rice is creamy. Stir in roasted butternut squash and Parmesan before serving.

column2: White fish fillets, Corn tortillas, Cabbage, Lime, Sour cream, Cilantro
column4: Season fish fillets and cook in a skillet until flaky. Warm corn tortillas. Fill with fish, shredded cabbage, and a squeeze of lime. Top with sour cream and fresh cilantro.

column2: Bell peppers, Ground turkey, Rice, Tomato sauce, Onion, Garlic, Cheese
column4: Cook ground turkey with onion and garlic. Stir in cooked rice and tomato sauce. Cut tops off bell peppers and remove seeds. Stuff peppers with filling, place in a baking dish, and bake at 375°F (190°C) until peppers are tender. Sprinkle with cheese before serving.

column2: Bread slices, Avocado, Lemon juice, Salt, Red pepper flakes, Olive oil
column4: Toast bread slices until golden. Mash avocado with lemon juice and salt. Spread onto toast, drizzle with olive oil, and sprinkle with red pepper flakes.

column2: Mushrooms, Onion, Garlic, Sour cream, Vegetable broth, Paprika, Egg noodles
column4: Sauté sliced mushrooms, onion, and garlic in butter until softened. Add vegetable broth and paprika, simmering for 10 minutes. Stir in sour cream to make a creamy sauce. Serve over cooked egg noodles.

column2: Tomatoes, Fresh mozzarella, Basil leaves, Olive oil, Balsamic glaze, Salt
column4: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella. Arrange on a plate with fresh basil leaves. Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze. Sprinkle lightly with salt before serving.

column2: Sweet potatoes, Coconut milk, Onion, Garlic, Curry powder, Spinach
column4: Sauté diced onion and garlic in oil until fragrant. Stir in curry powder and cubed sweet potatoes. Add coconut milk and simmer until potatoes are tender. Stir in spinach just before serving.

column2: Ziti pasta, Marinara sauce, Ricotta cheese, Mozzarella cheese, Parmesan cheese
column4: Cook ziti pasta until al dente. Mix pasta with marinara sauce and ricotta cheese. Transfer to a baking dish, top with mozzarella and Parmesan, and bake at 375°F (190°C) until cheese is melted and bubbly.

column2: Chicken breast, Bell peppers, Onion, Fajita seasoning, Tortillas
column4: Slice chicken and vegetables. Sauté in a skillet with fajita seasoning until chicken is cooked and vegetables are tender. Serve hot in warmed tortillas.

column2: Tomatoes, Onion, Garlic, Vegetable broth, Basil, Olive oil
column4: Sauté chopped onion and garlic in olive oil until fragrant. Add chopped tomatoes and vegetable broth. Simmer for 20 minutes, then blend until smooth. Stir in fresh basil before serving.

column2: Salmon fillets, Garlic, Butter, Lemon, Parsley, Salt
column4: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Melt butter with minced garlic and lemon juice. Place salmon fillets on a baking sheet, brush with garlic butter, and bake until flaky, about 12–15 minutes. Garnish with chopped parsley.

column2: Couscous, Cucumber, Tomato, Red onion, Parsley, Lemon juice, Olive oil
column4: Cook couscous according to package instructions and let cool. Toss with diced cucumber, tomato, and red onion. Add chopped parsley, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix well and serve chilled.

column2: Pork shoulder, BBQ sauce, Onion, Salt, Pepper
column4: Season pork shoulder with salt and pepper. Place in a slow cooker with sliced onion and cook on low for 6–8 hours until tender. Shred pork and mix with BBQ sauce before serving.

column2: Arborio rice, Vegetable broth, Peas, Carrots, Parmesan cheese, White wine
column4: Sauté diced carrots and peas in butter. Add Arborio rice and toast for 2 minutes. Deglaze with white wine. Gradually add hot vegetable broth, stirring constantly until rice is creamy. Stir in Parmesan before serving.

column2: Sushi rice, Nori, Cucumber, Avocado, Imitation crab, Soy sauce
column4: Prepare sushi rice and spread a thin layer on nori sheets. Add cucumber, avocado, and imitation crab. Roll tightly using a bamboo mat, slice into pieces, and serve with soy sauce.

column2: Beef strips, Mushrooms, Onion, Sour cream, Beef broth, Egg noodles
column4: Sauté beef strips in butter until browned. Add sliced mushrooms and onion, cooking until softened. Stir in beef broth and simmer for 10 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in sour cream. Serve over cooked egg noodles.

column2: Romaine lettuce, Chicken breast, Croutons, Parmesan cheese, Caesar dressing
column4: Grill or pan‑cook chicken breast until done, then slice. Toss romaine lettuce with Caesar dressing, croutons, and grated Parmesan. Top with sliced chicken and serve immediately.

column2: Lasagna noodles, Spinach, Ricotta, Mozzarella, Marinara sauce
column4: Cook lasagna noodles until al dente. Layer noodles with ricotta, spinach, mozzarella, and marinara sauce in a baking dish. Repeat layers and bake at 375°F (190°C) until cheese is melted and bubbly.

column2: Shrimp, Lemongrass, Lime juice, Fish sauce, Chili paste, Mushrooms
column4: Simmer vegetable broth with lemongrass, lime juice, fish sauce, and chili paste. Add shrimp and mushrooms, cooking until shrimp are pink and mushrooms tender. Serve hot with fresh herbs.

column2: Rice, Salmon or tuna, Cucumber, Soy sauce, Sesame oil, Scallions
column4: Cook rice and let cool slightly. Dice salmon or tuna and marinate briefly in soy sauce and sesame oil. Assemble bowl with rice, cucumber, marinated fish, and scallions.

column2: Bread, Eggs, Milk, Cinnamon, Butter
column4: Whisk eggs, milk, and cinnamon in a bowl. Dip bread slices into mixture. Cook on a buttered skillet until golden brown on both sides. Serve warm.

column2: Ground lamb, Carrots, Peas, Onion, Mashed potatoes
column4: Cook ground lamb with diced carrots, peas, and onion until tender. Transfer filling to a baking dish. Spread mashed potatoes evenly on top. Bake at 375°F (190°C) until golden brown.

column2: Beef slices, Soy sauce, Brown sugar, Garlic, Sesame oil, Scallions
column4: Marinate beef slices in soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and sesame oil for at least 30 minutes. Stir‑fry in a hot skillet until cooked through. Garnish with chopped scallions.

column2: Zucchini, Ground beef, Marinara sauce, Mozzarella
column4: Halve zucchinis lengthwise and scoop out centers. Cook ground beef with marinara sauce. Fill zucchini boats with beef mixture, top with mozzarella, and bake at 375°F (190°C) until tender.

column2: Tuna, Mayo, Celery, Bread, Salt, Pepper
column4: Mix canned tuna with mayonnaise, diced celery, salt, and pepper. Spread onto bread slices to make sandwiches.

column2: Ramen noodles, Broth, Egg, Scallions, Soy sauce, Garlic
column4: Cook ramen noodles in broth. Add soy sauce and garlic for flavor. Top with a boiled egg and chopped scallions before serving.

column2: Fettuccine, Chicken breast, Heavy cream, Parmesan cheese, Butter, Garlic
column4: Cook fettuccine until al dente. Sauté chicken breast pieces in butter and garlic. Add heavy cream and Parmesan to make sauce. Toss pasta with sauce and chicken.

column2: Pita bread, Tomato sauce, Mozzarella, Basil
column4: Spread tomato sauce on pita bread. Top with mozzarella and basil. Bake at 375°F (190°C) until cheese is melted.

column2: Mango, Red onion, Jalapeño, Lime juice, Cilantro, Salt
column4: Dice mango, red onion, and jalapeño. Mix with lime juice, chopped cilantro, and salt. Chill before serving.

column2: Beef strips, Broccoli, Soy sauce, Garlic, Cornstarch
column4: Stir‑fry beef strips in oil until browned. Add broccoli and cook until tender‑crisp. Stir in soy sauce, garlic, and cornstarch slurry. Cook until sauce thickens.

column2: Tomatoes, Cucumber, Bell pepper, Garlic, Olive oil, Vinegar
column4: Blend tomatoes, cucumber, bell pepper, garlic, olive oil, and vinegar until smooth. Chill for at least 1 hour before serving cold.

column2: Chicken, Carrots, Celery, Egg noodles, Chicken broth, Onion
column4: Sauté onion, carrots, and celery in oil. Add chicken and broth, simmer until chicken is cooked. Stir in egg noodles and cook until tender.

column2: Ground turkey, Egg, Bread crumbs, Garlic, Onion, Salt
column4: Mix ground turkey with egg, bread crumbs, garlic, onion, and salt. Form into meatballs. Bake at 375°F (190°C) or pan‑fry until cooked through.

column2: Shrimp, Pasta, Cream, Cajun seasoning, Garlic
column4: Cook pasta until al dente. Sauté shrimp with garlic and Cajun seasoning. Add cream to make sauce. Toss pasta with shrimp and sauce.

column2: Falafel, Lettuce, Tomato, Cucumber, Tahini, Rice
column4: Cook falafel according to package or recipe. Serve over rice with lettuce, tomato, cucumber, and drizzle with tahini.

column2: Avocado, Eggs, Lemon juice, Salt, Pepper
column4: Mash avocado with lemon juice, salt, and pepper. Chop boiled eggs and mix with avocado. Serve chilled.

column2: Eggplant, Zucchini, Bell peppers, Tomato, Onion, Garlic
column4: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil. Add diced eggplant, zucchini, and bell peppers. Stir in tomatoes and simmer until vegetables are tender.

column2: Pasta, Beans, Tomatoes, Carrots, Celery, Broth
column4: Sauté carrots, celery, and onion in oil. Add beans, tomatoes, and broth. Simmer for 20 minutes. Stir in pasta and cook until tender.

column2: Clams, Potatoes, Onion, Celery, Cream, Butter
column4: Sauté onion and celery in butter. Add diced potatoes and cook until tender. Stir in clams and cream. Simmer until thickened.

column2: Chicken broth, Tomatoes, Onion, Garlic, Tortilla strips
column4: Sauté onion and garlic. Add tomatoes and chicken broth. Simmer for 20 minutes. Top with crispy tortilla strips before serving.

column2: Noodles, Peanut butter, Soy sauce, Lime juice, Chili flakes
column4: Cook noodles and drain. Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, and chili flakes into a sauce. Toss noodles with sauce.

column2: Chicken thighs, Lemon, Garlic, Oregano, Olive oil
column4: Marinate chicken thighs in lemon juice, garlic, oregano, and olive oil. Roast at 400°F (200°C) until golden and cooked through.

column2: Baguette, Tomatoes, Basil, Garlic, Olive oil, Salt
column4: Toast baguette slices. Top with diced tomatoes, basil, garlic, olive oil, and salt. Serve immediately.

column2: Rice, Pork, Peas, Carrots, Soy sauce, Egg
column4: Cook diced pork in oil. Add peas and carrots, stir‑frying until tender. Stir in rice and soy sauce. Push rice aside, scramble egg, then mix everything together.

column2: Tofu, Broccoli, Soy sauce, Garlic, Sesame seeds
column4: Cube tofu and pan‑fry until crisp. Add broccoli and stir‑fry with soy sauce and garlic. Sprinkle with sesame seeds before serving.

column2: Beets, Goat cheese, Arugula, Walnuts, Olive oil
column4: Roast or boil beets until tender, then slice. Toss with arugula, goat cheese, walnuts, and olive oil.

column2: Chicken, Garlic, Yogurt, Cumin, Paprika, Pita bread
column4: Marinate chicken in yogurt, garlic, cumin, and paprika for at least 1 hour. Grill or roast until cooked. Serve in pita bread with toppings.

column2: Chicken broth, Eggs, Cornstarch, Scallions
column4: Bring chicken broth to a simmer. Stir in cornstarch slurry to thicken slightly. Slowly drizzle beaten eggs while stirring to form ribbons. Garnish with scallions.

column2: Pasta, Basil pesto, Parmesan cheese
column4: Cook pasta until al dente. Toss with basil pesto and sprinkle with Parmesan before serving.

column2: Shrimp, Garlic, Butter, Lemon, White wine, Pasta
column4: Cook pasta until al dente. Sauté shrimp in butter and garlic. Add lemon juice and white wine, simmer briefly. Toss shrimp and sauce with pasta.

column2: Bread, Cheddar cheese, Butter
column4: Butter bread slices and place cheddar cheese between them. Cook in a skillet until bread is golden and cheese is melted.

column2: Black beans, Onion, Garlic, Cumin, Broth
column4: Sauté onion and garlic in oil. Add black beans, cumin, and broth. Simmer for 20 minutes. Blend partially for a creamy texture.

column2: Cornmeal, Flour, Sugar, Milk, Eggs, Butter
column4: Mix cornmeal, flour, sugar, milk, eggs, and melted butter into batter. Pour into a greased pan and bake at 375°F (190°C) until golden.

column2: Chicken, Pita bread, Yogurt, Garlic, Cucumber, Tomato
column4: Marinate chicken in yogurt, garlic, and spices for at least 30 minutes. Grill or pan‑cook until golden and cooked through. Slice and serve in warm pita bread with diced cucumber, tomato, and a drizzle of yogurt sauce.

column2: Eggs, Tomatoes, Onion, Garlic, Paprika
column4: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until softened. Add chopped tomatoes and paprika, simmering until sauce thickens. Crack eggs into the sauce, cover, and cook until whites are set but yolks remain runny.

column2: Ground beef, Elbow pasta, Tomato sauce, Chili powder, Cheese
column4: Brown ground beef in a skillet. Stir in tomato sauce and chili powder, simmering for 10 minutes. Add cooked elbow pasta and toss. Sprinkle with cheese before serving.

column2: Soba noodles, Cucumber, Sesame oil, Soy sauce, Scallions
column4: Cook soba noodles, drain, and rinse under cold water. Toss with sliced cucumber, sesame oil, soy sauce, and chopped scallions. Chill before serving.

column2: Gnocchi, Butter, Garlic, Parmesan, Sage
column4: Cook gnocchi in boiling water until they float. In a skillet, melt butter with garlic and sage. Toss gnocchi in butter sauce and sprinkle with Parmesan.

column2: Chicken, Carrots, Peas, Pie crust, Cream
column4: Cook diced chicken with carrots and peas in butter until tender. Stir in cream to make filling. Pour into pie crust, cover with top crust, and bake at 375°F (190°C) until golden brown.

column2: Carrots, Ginger, Onion, Vegetable broth
column4: Sauté onion and ginger in oil until fragrant. Add chopped carrots and vegetable broth. Simmer until carrots are tender, then blend until smooth.

column2: Bread, Bacon, Lettuce, Tomato, Mayo
column4: Cook bacon until crisp. Toast bread slices. Spread with mayonnaise, then layer lettuce, tomato, and bacon. Serve immediately.

column2: Rice noodles, Cabbage, Soy sauce, Garlic, Egg
column4: Cook rice noodles and set aside. Stir‑fry cabbage and garlic in oil. Add noodles and soy sauce, tossing to coat. Push aside, scramble egg, then mix everything together.

column2: Eggs, Spinach, Cheese, Pie crust, Milk
column4: Whisk eggs and milk together. Stir in spinach and cheese. Pour into pie crust and bake at 375°F (190°C) until set and golden.

column2: Ground beef, Lettuce, Tomato, Cheese, Salsa, Sour cream
column4: Brown ground beef with taco seasoning. Arrange lettuce in a bowl, top with beef, diced tomato, shredded cheese, salsa, and sour cream.

column2: Pork, Ramen noodles, Broth, Egg, Scallions
column4: Simmer pork in broth until tender. Cook ramen noodles separately. Assemble bowl with noodles, broth, sliced pork, boiled egg, and scallions.

column2: Eggs, Bell peppers, Onion, Spinach, Cheese
column4: Sauté diced bell peppers, onion, and spinach until softened. Beat eggs and pour into skillet. Cook until set, sprinkle with cheese, and fold omelette.

column2: Tortillas, Chicken, Enchilada sauce, Cheese
column4: Shred cooked chicken and mix with enchilada sauce. Fill tortillas with chicken mixture, roll up, and place in baking dish. Top with more sauce and cheese. Bake until bubbly.

column2: Pasta, Garlic, Lemon, Parmesan, Olive oil
column4: Cook pasta until al dente. Sauté garlic in olive oil, add lemon juice and zest. Toss pasta with sauce and sprinkle with Parmesan.

column2: Ground beef, Elbow pasta, Tomato sauce, Onion, Paprika
column4: Brown ground beef with onion. Stir in tomato sauce and paprika. Add cooked elbow pasta and simmer until flavors meld.

column2: Chickpeas, Tomato, Onion, Garlic, Garam masala
column4: Sauté onion and garlic in oil. Add tomatoes and garam masala, cooking until fragrant. Stir in chickpeas and simmer until sauce thickens.

column2: Lentils, Coconut milk, Onion, Garlic, Curry powder
column4: Sauté onion and garlic in oil. Add lentils, curry powder, and coconut milk. Simmer until lentils are tender and sauce thickens.

column2: Kimchi, Rice, Egg, Scallions, Soy sauce
column4: Sauté chopped kimchi in oil. Add rice and soy sauce, stir‑frying until heated through. Push aside, scramble egg, then mix everything together. Garnish with scallions.

column2: Beef broth, Rice noodles, Beef slices, Herbs, Lime
column4: Simmer beef broth with spices for depth. Cook rice noodles separately. Assemble bowl with noodles, thin beef slices, hot broth, fresh herbs, and lime.

column2: Penne, Tomato sauce, Garlic, Red chili flakes, Olive oil
column4: Cook penne until al dente. Sauté garlic and chili flakes in olive oil. Add tomato sauce and simmer. Toss pasta with sauce and serve.

column2: Chicken, Tortilla, Cheese, Salsa
column4: Cook shredded chicken in a skillet. Place tortilla in pan, fill with chicken and cheese, fold, and cook until golden. Serve with salsa.

column2: Pumpkin puree, Onion, Garlic, Cream, Broth
column4: Sauté onion and garlic in butter. Add pumpkin puree and broth, simmering until heated. Stir in cream and blend until smooth.

column2: Assorted vegetables, Tempura batter, Oil
column4: Dip vegetables into tempura batter. Fry in hot oil until crisp and golden. Drain on paper towels and serve immediately.

column2: Spinach, Banana, Yogurt, Milk
column4: Combine spinach, banana, yogurt, and milk in a blender. Blend until smooth and creamy.

column2: Rice, Chicken, Onion, Saffron, Spices
column4: Sauté onion and spices in oil. Add chicken pieces and cook until browned. Layer rice and chicken with saffron water. Cover and cook until rice is fluffy and chicken tender.

column2: Ground pork, Thai basil, Garlic, Chili, Soy sauce
column4: Sauté garlic and chili in oil. Add ground pork and cook until browned. Stir in soy sauce and Thai basil, cooking until fragrant.

column2: Turkey slices, Bread, Lettuce, Tomato, Mayo
column4: Layer turkey slices, lettuce, and tomato between bread slices. Spread with mayonnaise and serve.

column2: Tilapia, Lemon, Garlic, Olive oil, Parsley
column4: Place tilapia fillets on a baking sheet. Drizzle with olive oil, lemon juice, and minced garlic. Bake at 375°F (190°C) until tender. Garnish with parsley.

column2: Tortellini, Cream, Parmesan, Butter
column4: Cook tortellini until tender. In a skillet, melt butter and stir in cream and Parmesan. Toss tortellini in sauce and serve.

column2: Lettuce, Tomato, Cucumber, Red onion, Feta, Vinaigrette
column4: Chop lettuce, tomato, cucumber, and red onion. Toss with crumbled feta and vinaigrette. Serve chilled.

column2: Mixed vegetables, Coconut milk, Curry powder, Garlic, Onion
column4: Sauté onion and garlic in oil until softened. Stir in curry powder and mixed vegetables. Add coconut milk, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until vegetables are tender.
